why_it_matters: Safe YAML reading rejected shared-object aliases.
smallest_credible_fix: Normalize YAML through the JSON-compatible logical payload.

why_it_matters: Nil policies raised NoMethodError and normalized duplicate names were silently overwritten.
smallest_credible_fix: Use validated copied definitions before mutation.

why_it_matters: false was treated as reset-all and erased levels.
smallest_credible_fix: Distinguish nil from invalid signal names.

why_it_matters: Class and inline declarations ignored runtime variant-name collisions.
smallest_credible_fix: Validate against current adapter variants before binding.

why_it_matters: Changing catalogue keys could retain more than the 32-key level budget.
smallest_credible_fix: Check retained names on new-key observation; require reset at capacity.

why_it_matters: An undeclared custom rescue signal failed only after business code raised.
smallest_credible_fix: Validate custom policy before executing paths.

why_it_matters: A rolled-back threshold emitted observe and park success events.
smallest_credible_fix: Publish after all enclosing transactions commit.

why_it_matters: Bypassing every transaction preload raised a 50-row index from 1 to 51 gate queries.
smallest_credible_fix: Bind preloads to transaction and adapter identity; bypass shared caches only.

why_it_matters: A deterministic interleaving admitted 8 competing bindings instead of 1.
smallest_credible_fix: Check and publish inside the same lock.

why_it_matters: CSV export failed in a minimal consumer Gemfile with LoadError.
smallest_credible_fix: Encode the fixed CSV row contract with String operations and prove round trips.

why_it_matters: Repeated filter-help ids and mismatched aria-describedby broke field descriptions.
smallest_credible_fix: Prefix description ids with their feature/experiment owner.

why_it_matters: Inline delivery ignored unknown configured arm names.
smallest_credible_fix: Validate configured arm names for both execution entry points.

why_it_matters: Repeated expanded audience forms placed signals below the sampled 1800px desktop surface.
smallest_credible_fix: Show signals first and use native details for audiences.
